property_summary: For any caller and any withdraw amount ≤ their recorded balance, if the recipient reverts on receiving Ether then the reference contract's withdraw will revert (so the caller's recorded balance and contract balance remain unchanged), while the mutant using unchecked low-level call may not revert and can still decrement the caller's recorded balance even though no Ether left the contract.
change_summary: Change transfer to send (low-level call) and ignore its result, altering external call behavior and potential reentrancy/outcome visible after withdraw.
